goal: A small Rust/WebAssembly web-application framework (ferric) and a Twitter-style clone (chirp) built on it, production quality; built, tested, and continuously delivered via GitHub Actions CI and ArgoCD on k3s; reachable on the cluster. The GitHub Project, issues, and PRs are the working record.
flow: Each unit of work is a forked swe-coder DAG on a feature branch -> pushes -> opens a PR into main referencing its issue -> overseer schedules a review DAG -> overseer gates/merges. CI via GitHub Actions; CD via ArgoCD on k3s. Bugs -> issues -> fix DAGs. Lockfile/rebase conflicts (a sibling landing restales an open PR's Cargo.lock) are cleared by a forked relock/rebase DAG, never inline (P1). (This PR-into-main flow follows the explicit user request and supersedes the app's local-first default.)

architecture.framework: ferric (crates/ferric): client-side WASM framework — reactive signals, component model, DOM rendering (wasm-bindgen/web-sys), router, fetch/JSON http client
architecture.app: chirp: crates/chirp-types (shared contract), crates/chirp-server (axum REST API + persistence + static SPA serving), crates/chirp-frontend (ferric SPA)
architecture.deploy: chirp-server containerized; k8s manifests under deploy/; ArgoCD Application tracking the repo deploys to k3s

known_patterns.lockfile_restale_on_land: Every land to main moves the base and restales the Cargo.lock of every still-open sibling PR that branched from an earlier commit. Each such PR goes CONFLICTING/DIRTY on Cargo.lock and must be cleared by a forked relock/rebase swe-coder DAG (check out work/<slug>, merge/rebase origin/main, regenerate Cargo.lock via cargo build, re-run the synthesis gate, push) BEFORE it can land. Never resolved inline (P1). First observed at I14: landing #16 (ferric-router #5) at I13 restaled PR #15 (ferric-http #6); I15 forked ferric-http-relock-r1 to clear it. Expect PR #17 (chirp-types #7) and future #8/#9 PRs to need the same when they are next in line to land (landing #6 will restale PR #17).
known_patterns.gh_mergeability_async: gh pr view returns mergeable/mergeStateStatus=UNKNOWN on a fresh query; GitHub computes it asynchronously. Re-poll until it is not UNKNOWN before gating a land. Never land on UNKNOWN; never land CONFLICTING.
known_patterns.gh_self_review_block: gh pr review --approve is rejected (Can not approve your own pull request) because the authenticated gh account authored the PR; the fallback posts --comment (state COMMENTED). The authoritative APPROVE/REQUEST-CHANGES verdict is in the review DAG's SYNTHESIS.md body, not the gh review state.
known_patterns.gate_on_synthesis_not_review_body: A review DAG that has produced/posted a review-body.md (even with intended verdict APPROVE) but has NOT written its root SYNTHESIS.md / COMPLETE.md has NOT folded. The overseer gates on the folded SYNTHESIS.md verdict record, never on a posted review body alone. First applied at I15: review-chirp-types had posted an APPROVE review to PR #17 but had no root SYNTHESIS.md (scheduler log: still Running) -> I15 did NOT land PR #17; watch for its fold.
